name: 17050 · Mechanicsburg, PA
findings: ZIP 17050 (Mechanicsburg) has 167 nonprofit organizations. 99 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 86 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17050 (Mechanicsburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17050 (Mechanicsburg) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
